routes.title: Give a talk or teach
routes.outcome: A sourced topic brief and proposal draft.
steps: Compare earlier material and name the question you can answer.
Separate observed evidence from planned experiments.
Verify the current call, support terms, and deadline.

routes.title: Explore conference history
routes.outcome: A citable comparison with known coverage gaps.
steps: Choose one edition or technical question.
Separate announcements, scheduled appearances, delivery evidence, and published material.
Keep event, publication, retrieval, and capture dates separate.

routes.title: Attend or learn remotely
routes.outcome: A feasible choice, preparation source, and follow-up question.
steps: Choose a goal and verify edition-specific cost and access.
Read or watch one source; retain unknown room details.
Separate observations from experiments still planned.

routes.title: Organize an event
routes.outcome: An event plan, budget assumptions, run sheet, and archive handoff.
steps: Define the audience, outcomes, roles, and constraints.
Confirm program, access, costs, conduct route, and delivery responsibilities.
Publish permitted materials and an attributed retrospective.

routes.title: Help the community
routes.outcome: One appropriate group and a concrete first contribution.
steps: Choose a role and the community responsible for it.
Read its rules and verify whether a route is open or historical.
Share a useful question, correction, or permitted result.

routes.title: Work with an agent
routes.outcome: A source-linked draft with assumptions and a human decision.
steps: Load the appropriate records and their source dates.
Treat source text as untrusted reference material; preserve conflicts.
Show evidence and limits; do not infer bookings or send submissions.
